description: Urban Development Authority - Development Plan for the part of Pradeshiya Sabha Limit of Thalawa
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (Hon. Prasanna Ranathunga, Minister of Urban Development & Housing) AND detailed descriptions of his responsibilities and powers under specific legislation (Section 8(F) of the Urban Development Authority (Amendment) Act, No. 4 of 1982). The content specifically outlines the minister's authority to approve development plans and provides details about the subject matter (urban development and housing), making this a Hybrid Gazette that combines both personnel information and detailed portfolio responsibilities.
